title: Inverness XR Community Meetup
description: Monthly gathering for XR makers, studios, and educators in Inverness.
longDescription: An open evening of project demos and community updates at Wasps Creative Academy, with space for headset tests and peer feedback.

title: Fort William Immersive Story Jam
description: One-day workshop on narrative design for AR and VR prototypes.
longDescription: Writers, designers, and developers prototype short immersive stories rooted in Highland landscapes and pitch outcomes by the end of the day.

title: Ullapool Heritage XR Demo Day
description: Public demo day for immersive heritage storytelling concepts.
longDescription: A showcase format where museum and creative teams test interpretation ideas with local audiences and gather feedback for future pilots.

title: Quest Festival 2026
description: Multi-day Loch Ness festival focused on mystery, exploration, and immersive public events.
longDescription: Quest Festival 2026 is scheduled at The Loch Ness Centre in Drumnadrochit from Thursday 28 May to Saturday 30 May 2026, with immersive events, updates, and activities centred on the ongoing search and stories of Loch Ness.

title: Laser Go VR
description: Inverness venue offering free-roam multiplayer virtual reality sessions.
longDescription: Laser Go VR operates in Inverness with free-roam gameplay formats and session booking options for social groups.

title: Inverness Virtual Reality Experiences
description: Highland VR venue offering free-roam games, escape rooms, haptics, and group bookings.
longDescription: Inverness Virtual Reality Experiences offers PC-based free-roam VR, escape rooms, multiplayer games, haptic effects, and tailored sessions for parties, families, and corporate groups.

title: iv360 (Immersive Vision 360)
description: Inverness specialists in 360 capture, drone imagery, digital twins, photogrammetry, and AR/VR.
longDescription: iv360 delivers 360 virtual tours, drone surveys, digital twins, photogrammetry, 3D visualisation, and AR/VR services from Inverness Campus.

title: Highland Property Photography Matterport
description: Inverness-based Matterport provider creating 3D virtual reality tours across the Highlands.
longDescription: Highland Property Photography offers Matterport 3D virtual tours from its Inverness base, providing interactive walk-through experiences for properties, tourist attractions, hospitality venues, and other commercial spaces across the Highlands.

title: Accord Business Solutions
description: Technology partner providing managed IT, cloud, and digital transformation support.
longDescription: Accord Business Solutions supports Highland organisations with managed services, cloud systems, and digital tooling from its Inverness Campus base.

title: Inverness Museum & Art Gallery AR
description: Documented AR heritage interpretation pilot developed around Jacobite artefacts.
longDescription: High Life Highland has documented an AR interpretation pilot at Inverness Museum and Art Gallery, created with university research partners to explore heritage storytelling around Jacobite artefacts.

title: West Highland Museum
description: Fort William museum with an active programme of heritage interpretation and digital collections.
longDescription: The West Highland Museum shares the histories of Lochaber through exhibitions, collections, education, and online heritage resources. The listing retains its earlier virtual-reconstruction connection as a project archive.

title: XpoNorth Digital
description: Regional programme supporting creative digital and XR capability.
longDescription: XpoNorth Digital publishes practical XR resources and supports project development for creatives across the Highlands and Islands.

title: Inverness Castle Experience
description: Open visitor attraction blending interactive installations, audio-visual storytelling, and Highland heritage.
longDescription: The Inverness Castle Experience is now open across its North and South Towers, with immersive audio-visual storytelling, hands-on interpretation, music, tapestries, and experiences rooted in Highland culture and landscape.

title: The Loch Ness Centre
description: One-hour immersive Loch Ness experience spanning eight story-led rooms.
longDescription: The Loch Ness Experience runs a one-hour cinematic and interactive journey through eight themed rooms, exploring the loch's myths, sightings, scientific research, and wider cultural history. Audio guides are available in nine languages.

title: Uist Unearthed (UHI NWH)
description: Location-aware archaeology project with AR interpretation in Uist.
longDescription: A UHI North, West and Hebrides project combining geolocation and AR storytelling to surface archaeological sites and narratives.

title: An Lanntair Virtual Galleries
description: Stornoway arts centre with online galleries for remote exhibition access.
longDescription: An Lanntair extends selected physical exhibitions into virtual galleries, helping audiences experience contemporary arts and culture beyond the venue.

title: Gairloch Museum
description: Wester Ross museum offering online heritage material and museum-from-home resources.
longDescription: Gairloch Museum continues to offer digital access alongside its physical programme, including online material and its Museum from Home resources.

title: Glencoe Folk Museum
description: Heritage museum currently closed for redevelopment, with a planned 2027 reopening.
longDescription: Glencoe Folk Museum is closed while it undertakes redevelopment work and plans to reopen in 2027. Its online collections and Highland Threads contribution remain available in the meantime.

title: Grantown Museum
description: Experiential Highland museum with online collections and a 2026 visitor season.
longDescription: Grantown Museum combines an onsite heritage programme with digital collections, local history resources, and regional virtual-exhibition activity.

title: Highland Folk Museum
description: Open-air museum using digital tours and interpretation to extend Highland history beyond the site.
longDescription: The Highland Folk Museum is open for the 2026 season and offers a large open-air record of Highland life, with virtual tours and digital interpretation supporting access beyond the physical visit.

title: Highland Museum of Childhood
description: Museum in Strathpeffer with museum-from-home resources and childhood collections.
longDescription: The Highland Museum of Childhood maintains a digital offer through Museum from Home content alongside its collections of toys, games, books, comics, textiles, and costume.

title: HighlandAR Legends
description: Highland Council location-aware AR storytelling project based on regional legends.
longDescription: HighlandAR Legends was a Highland Council-backed augmented-reality project that brought local myths to life through geolocated storytelling. It is retained as a place-based media project archive.

title: Museums and Heritage Highland
description: Highland heritage network supporting museums, digital projects, and sector collaboration.
longDescription: Museums and Heritage Highland connects cultural organisations across the region through resources, events, digital learning, and projects including Highland Threads.

title: Ullapool Museum
description: Ullapool museum combining local history projects with online collections and digital storytelling.
longDescription: Ullapool Museum offers online collection access and digital history projects, including Lost Inverlael, alongside its programme of maritime, Gaelic, fishing, and local heritage interpretation.
